title: Tokens with a fee-on-transfer mechanism will break the protocol
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as some users will lose value  **Likelihood:** Low, as such tokens are not common  ## Description  The ERC20 logic in `BloomPool` is incompatible with tokens that have a fee-on-transfer mechanism. Such tokens for example is `PAXG`, while `USDT` has a built-in fee-on-transfer mechanism that is currently switched off.
